newsitem.title: USA: USAir changes name to US Airways Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: USAir changes name to US Airways Feb 27.

text.p: USAir Group Inc said it officially will change its name to US Airways Group Inc on Thursday.
The company previously announced plans change its name, logo and plane paint scheme in an effort to reflect its "evolving position among domestic and international airlines."

The company said it will take about three years to repaint the exterior of its fleet and two years to renovate the interiors. The airline will change its logo at airports and ticket offices over the next six months.
